blends.desc: This is it! Our girls have had their time in the main party, and now it is time for their AFTER PARTY! Get a single, animated Lady from our Single Ladies edition. You could get lucky and get a low mint number, or you could get fodder to use to bring a CUPCAKE QUEEN to life. You'll also require our SINGLE LADIES to get Out of the Kitchen, which will be our next edition, launching soon!
